g.text: UC.24 - Departmental Shift Handover Reporting & Sign-off
1. Open Shift Handover Form & enter shift tasks, incidents, handover notes
9. SELECT * FROM shift_reports WHERE department_id=dept_id AND status='SUBMITTED'
11a. Enter Manager Remarks & click Sign-off & Approve
11b. Enter revision remarks & click Request Revision
13b. UPDATE shift_reports SET status='REJECTED' (unlock for employee)
Notify employee to revise and resubmit
